'''Fhorjak ''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]] he served as the shipboard security onboard the [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] [[Gav Daragon (Valor-class)|''Gav Daragon'']], where he connected Republic forces with a [[Holocomm/Legends|holocommunication]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shol Bestros]] concerning [[Soa]], The Infernal One.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Colonel Fhorjak appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Operation Courier for "The Eternity Vault" operation.<ref name="SWTOR" />
